title: A fair measure leaves room for lightness

captions.energy: Finding a balance between different needs

meaning: Your considerate reconciliation of needs can leave room for lightness when a new idea respects both people’s capacities.
text: Lightness can feel especially warm when it does not have to displace someone’s needs. In the physical position of Anahata, Justice expresses care through honest decisions about time, help and the consequences of a shared step. Temperance in energy brings a wish to combine different needs and find a suitable measure without pressure. The Fool in emotions offers openness to the unfamiliar and pleasure in a beginning not yet defined. You may feel free together when a new experience does not require abandoning respect for your actual capacities.

For example, after household tasks you have the idea of visiting an open pottery class for the first time. One person is curious while the other wants to keep part of the evening free. You agree honestly to try it briefly and share the remaining tasks beforehand. **A free step feels warmer when both have room for it.** At the class you can laugh awkwardly at a first cup without proving that this new idea must become a shared passion.

Agreement can turn into endless preparation that leaves no time for a living step. Yet lightness also loses warmth when someone’s hesitation is dismissed as excessive seriousness. Care keeps its measure when a trial remains a trial: you can enjoy it differently, finish earlier or choose not to repeat it. Honest involvement requires no identical enthusiasm for everything new.
